description: Election Commission - Mrs. W. K. K. Shanthilatha of the Thissamaharama Pradeshiya Sabha Vacated his Office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha - Mr. M. L. M. Haneefa of the  Thissamaharama Pradeshiya Sabha Vacated his Office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that two members of the Thissamaharama Pradeshiya Sabha have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected local government officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) for matters concerning electoral processes and related administrative actions.
